objective: Exercise the in-guest world_model_preview service through four simultaneous host WebSocket clients with independently correlated request identifiers and bounded read-only authority.
runtime_change_allowed: bounded cooperative preview-only client slots and the minimum listener lifecycle needed to accept simultaneous sockets
runtime_change_forbidden: granting preview-only clients execute_tool, agent_step, neural commit, or physical delivery authority
modifying the packaged source disk during an evidence run
scheduling: All four clients open before the timed phase. A deterministic barrier releases 128 requests with client-qualified IDs. The verifier retains per-client send and response timestamps.
failure_probe: After the first batch, one preview-only client disconnects and reconnects; the other clients must continue receiving correctly correlated responses and the reconnected client must re-pair before preview.
metrics: responses and schema validity per client
per-client median, p95 and maximum latency
Jain fairness index over per-client throughput
packaged source disk digest before and after
gates: four distinct WebSocket transports pair and receive responses
128 of 128 timed responses are received with no cross-client leakage
all responses satisfy the preview schema
Jain throughput fairness is at least 0.95
disconnect isolation and explicit re-pair pass
zero execution dataset records are added
packaged source disk digest is unchanged
promotion: No model or disk promotion is permitted by this protocol.
claim_boundary: Passing establishes bounded multi-client contention for read-only previews in one QEMU guest. It does not establish parallel neural execution, distributed multi-host consensus, production load capacity, or action-execution safety under contention.
